description.en: Five fortified Israeli positions just north of the Blue Line.

sources.quote: The older bases were established during the Hezbollah-Israel conflict in 2024.

description.en: Security zone along the border up to about 10-12 km deep (about 6% of Lebanon), bounded by an Israeli-declared 'Yellow Line' whose course shifts; ~30 Israeli positions incl. eight fortified bases (UNIFIL, Sept 2026).

sources.quote: Lebanese civilians are prohibited from entering the zone, which covers approximately 6% of the country's territory
Israeli forces are now operating from nearly 30 military positions across south Lebanon, including eight fortified bases

notes.en: No polygon. The ground offensive began in March 2026 (day not verified in an opened source).
